description: Create a file in a GitLab project, or update it if it already exists.

branch.description: The branch to commit the file change to.

commit_message.description: The commit message for the file creation or update.

content.description: The full text content to write to the file.

file_path.description: The path of the file within the repository to create or update.

previous_path.description: Optional previous path of the file when renaming or moving it.

project_id.description: The GitLab project identifier: a numeric ID or URL-encoded project path.

name: create_or_update_file
